feed.title: Past The Label — top value wines
feed.subtitle: This week's best-value bottles at Arrowine, The Wine Cabinet and Winetonomy.

entry.title: Champagne Egly-Ouriet Grand Cru Blanc de Noirs NV — 87/100 Elite
entry.summary: 87/100 · Elite · $370 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the most compelling grower Champagnes in existence, and the price, while steep, is genuinely hard to argue with given what's in the bottle.

entry.title: Champagne Tarlant La Vigne d'Antan Brut Nature Blanc de Blancs 2006 — 82/100 Elite
entry.summary: 82/100 · Elite · $330 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — A truly exceptional bottle — and arguably the more intellectually interesting of the two Tarlants at this price.

entry.title: Blandy's Madeira Terrantez Vintage 1987 — 79/100 Elite
entry.summary: 79/100 · Elite · $450 · Arrowine & Cheese — One of the genuinely irreplaceable bottles in this batch, and the price is easy to justify.

entry.title: Domaine de la Pepiere Muscadet Sèvre-et-Maine Sur Lie "La Pépie" 2025 — 78/100 Elite
entry.summary: 78/100 · Elite · $22 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — One of the clearest buys in this batch — the benchmark Muscadet producer at essentially the benchmark price.

entry.title: 2016 Descendientes de José Palacios, Bierzo Villa de Corullón 95+ — 78/100 Elite
entry.summary: 78/100 · Elite · $50 · Winetonomy, Spain — A standout buy.

entry.title: 2021 G.D. Vajra Barolo Ravera 98pts! — 78/100 Elite
entry.summary: 78/100 · Elite · $90 · Winetonomy, Italy — A top-tier buy and the one to grab here.

entry.title: Birichino Mokelumne River Cinsault Bechthold Vineyard "Vignes Centenaires" 2023 — 77/100 Elite
entry.summary: 77/100 · Elite · $35 · Arrowine & Cheese, California — Buy this immediately — it's one of the most distinctive value wines on the list.

entry.title: Vietti Barolo 'Monvigliero' 2020 — 77/100 Elite
entry.summary: 77/100 · Elite · $260 · Arrowine & Cheese, Barolo — The most compelling of the three Vietti Barolos at this price, and the one I'd buy first.

entry.title: 2022 Envinate Palo Blanco 98 — 77/100 Elite
entry.summary: 77/100 · Elite · $55 · Winetonomy, Spain — A standout for adventurous white drinkers.

entry.title: Les Foulards Rouges "La Soif du Mal" RED 2023 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $40 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A serious buy for the adventurous drinker who wants Grenache that tastes like it came from somewhere specific.

entry.title: Champagne Roses de Jeanne "Les Ursules" Blanc de Noirs 2020 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $400 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the most compelling grower Champagnes made today, though you are paying for it — this is a specialist purchase, not an everyday splurge.

entry.title: Vietti Barolo 'Cerequio' 2020 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $260 · Arrowine & Cheese, Barolo — A serious buy for anyone building a cellar.

entry.title: Two Mountain Yakima Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $23 · Arrowine & Cheese — A genuinely strong buy for $23 — this is an estate Cabernet from named, documented vineyards in Rattlesnake Hills, a Yakima Valley sub-AVA that punches well above its recognition level.

entry.title: Domaine Clape Saint Peray Blanc 2022 — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $100 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A genuine buy for anyone who loves serious Northern Rhône whites — Clape is one of the benchmark estates of the appellation, and this vintage now includes a parcel of 70-year-old Marsanne that meaningfully lifts the wine.

entry.title: Champagne Jerome Prévost La Closerie "Les Béguines" Extra Brut LC23 — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $370 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the most distinctive grower Champagnes in the world, and the price — while steep — is genuinely hard to argue with given what's in the bottle.

entry.title: Vietti Barolo Lazzarito 2020 — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $260 · Arrowine & Cheese, Barolo — The more structured, austere sibling to the Cerequio — and a compelling buy for a patient cellar.

entry.title: Champagne Roses de Jeanne "Les Ursules" Blanc de Noirs 2021 — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $400 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the most compelling arguments for $400 Champagne you'll find.

entry.title: Ken Wright Canary Hill Vineyard Pinot Noir 2019 750ml — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $50 · The Wine Cabinet — A well-credentialed single-vineyard Oregon Pinot from one of the Willamette Valley's most site-specific producers, and at $49.99 it is genuinely good value for what's on offer.

entry.title: 2019 Descendientes de José Palacios, Bierzo Villa de Corullón 96! — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $60 · Winetonomy, Spain — A strong buy if you want serious Bierzo at a fraction of what comparable Priorat or Rioja trophies cost.

entry.title: 2016 Damilano Barolo Cannubi 1.5L 98pts! — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $180 · Winetonomy, Italy — A strong buy: a Cannubi Barolo from a documented top producer in a great vintage, in magnum, for about $90 per standard bottle.

entry.title: Torbreck Hillside Vineyard Grenache 2021 — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $90 · Arrowine & Cheese, Australia — A serious buy for old-vine Barossa Grenache at the single-vineyard level — this is the kind of bottle that justifies the $90 price tag.

entry.title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello 2020 — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $150 · Arrowine & Cheese, Brunello — A serious buy for anyone who wants genuine Brunello at this price point.

entry.title: Domaine Philémon Gaillac Perlé Nature 2024 — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $18 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A strong buy at this price and an easy recommendation for anyone willing to look past the familiar.

entry.title: Taylor Fladgate Vintage Port 2003 750ml — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $150 · The Wine Cabinet — A serious, age-worthy Vintage Port from one of the great names in the Douro — the 2003 was a legendary, scorching vintage that produced concentrated, powerful wines with decades of runway, and Taylor Fladgate is among the handful of shippers who still farm and declare at the highest level.

entry.title: Clemens Busch Mosel Riesling Trocken "LS" 2024 — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $40 · Arrowine & Cheese, Germany — A serious buy from one of the Mosel's most compelling growers.

entry.title: Mauro Veglio Barbera D'Alba 2025 — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $27 · Arrowine & Cheese, Italy — A very good buy for Barbera at this price from a serious Langhe producer.

entry.title: Punset Barbaresco Riserva 2017 750ml — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $70 · The Wine Cabinet — A genuine buy for anyone who wants serious Barbaresco without paying Gaja prices.

entry.title: 2020 Clos i Terrasses Clos Erasmus Priorat 100! — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $300 · Winetonomy, Spain — A genuine trophy bottle and one of the few at this price that earns it.

entry.title: 2021 Envinate La Santa de Úrsula 95+ — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $55 · Winetonomy, Spain — A strong buy if you like savory, high-toned Atlantic reds.

entry.title: 2022 Kellerei Terlan Alto Adige Pinot Bianco Vorberg Riserva — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $50 · Winetonomy, Italy — A smart buy for the money.

entry.title: 2021 Casanova Di Neri Brunello di Montalcino 95pts! — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $85 · Winetonomy, Italy — A strong buy for Brunello at this price.

entry.title: Gonzalez Byass Leonor Palo Cortado Seco Sherry NV (375ml) — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $20 · Arrowine & Cheese, Spain — A standout for anyone curious about savory, nutty, bone-dry wine.

entry.title: Remelluri Rioja Reserva 2018 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $53 · Arrowine & Cheese, Spain — One of the strongest buys in this batch — a serious, Atlantic-style Rioja Reserva from a genuine estate at a price that still leaves room.

entry.title: Domaine Sérol Côte Roannaise Les Blondins 2023 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $32 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A genuine standout at this price — Côte Roannaise Gamay on volcanic granite is one of the Loire's best-kept secrets.

entry.title: Champagne Jose Michel et Fils Special Club Extra Brut 2016 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $110 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — A serious grower Champagne from a house with roots back to 1847 and a cult following built by José Michel over six decades of Pinot Meunier mastery — this is exactly the kind of bottle the framework is designed to surface.

entry.title: Valdicava "Madonna del Piano" Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2012 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $400 · Arrowine & Cheese, Brunello — Valdicava's Madonna del Piano is one of the cult single-vineyard Brunello Riservas — a wine from a tiny, obsessively farmed estate in the northern Montalcino zone, where the galestro soils and elevation produce some of the most mineral, tensile Sangiovese in the appellation.

entry.title: Artadi Vinas de Gain Blanco 2018 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $22 · Arrowine & Cheese, Spain — A genuine steal hiding behind an unglamorous grape name.

entry.title: Champagne Jacques Lassaigne Clos Sainte Sophie 2015 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $350 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — A genuinely special grower Champagne from one of Montgueux's most celebrated addresses, but at $350 the math is brutal.

entry.title: Domaine de la Fond Moiroux, Moulin-à-Vent, Gros Vosges, 2023 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $30 · Arrowine & Cheese, Beaujolais — A strong buy and one of the better-value bottles in this batch.

entry.title: Agrapart Champagne Extra Brut Blanc de Blanc Grand Cru "Terrroirs" NV — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $145 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the most serious non-vintage Champagnes available at any price, and a genuine buy even at $145.

entry.title: 2017 G.D. Vajra Barolo Bricco delle Viole 96pts! — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $78 · Winetonomy, Italy — A standout buy.

entry.title: 2020 Clos i Terrasses Clos Erasmus 'Laurel' Priorat 96! — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $70 · Winetonomy, Spain — A strong buy if you want a serious Priorat at a fair price.

entry.title: 2016 La Rioja Alta Vina Ardanza Reserva Especial — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $45 · Winetonomy, Spain — A standout buy for traditional Rioja lovers.

entry.title: Domaine Specht Riesling Grand Cru Mandelberg 2022 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $45 · Arrowine & Cheese, alsace — A strong buy: grand cru Riesling from a named steep limestone-marl site at under $45 is hard to match.

entry.title: Tempier Bandol “La Migoua” 2023 (Previous Vintage) — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $110 · Arrowine & Cheese, bandol — A genuinely exciting Bandol single-vineyard rosé — sorry, red — from one of the most legendary estates in southern France, but the 2023 vintage at $110 is a steep ask for a wine that really needs time.

entry.title: Lustau Deluxe Cream Sherry Solera Reserva Capataz Andres Sherry — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $27 · Arrowine & Cheese, Sherry — A genuinely excellent Cream Sherry at a very fair price from one of Jerez's most respected houses — and Cream Sherry is a style that almost nobody buys, which keeps the price honest.

entry.title: Weingut Bastgen Weinstein Riesling Trocken 2023 750ml — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $27 · The Wine Cabinet — A very compelling value buy for a dry (Trocken) Mosel Riesling from what appears to be a small, quality-focused estate.

entry.title: Antoine-Marie Arena Biancu Ghjentile 2022 — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $52 · Arrowine & Cheese, corsica — A standout buy for anyone who wants a genuinely rare white wine with real depth and a story that matters.

entry.title: Champagne Roses de Jeanne "Les Ursules" Blanc de Noirs 2017 — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $400 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — A genuine buy for the grower-Champagne obsessive who wants one of the most singular expressions of Pinot Noir blanc de noirs in the appellation — but the price demands a clear-eyed look.

entry.title: G.D. Vajra Langhe Rosso 2025 — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $20 · Arrowine & Cheese, Italy — A strong buy — this is G.D.
